subsystems.name: Perception
subsystems.role: sense the user's presence, face, voice, and environment.

subsystems.name: Cognition and dialogue
subsystems.role: understand speech, generate responses, and learn user habits.

subsystems.name: Expression and actuation
subsystems.role: show emotion and attention through movement, light, and sound.

subsystems.name: Compute and connectivity
subsystems.role: run local AI and connect to cloud services.

subsystems.name: Power and chassis
subsystems.role: power the robot and provide a stable, appealing physical form.

buildSteps.title: Define interaction goals and form factor
buildSteps.detail: Decide what emotions and tasks the robot should support, then sketch the body and sensor placement.

buildSteps.title: Design and prototype the hardware
buildSteps.detail: Create mechanical designs, 3D-print prototypes, and integrate motors, sensors, and electronics.

buildSteps.title: Develop perception software
buildSteps.detail: Implement face detection, emotion recognition, voice activity detection, and speaker identification.

buildSteps.title: Integrate the language model
buildSteps.detail: Connect to a cloud or local large language model, build dialogue management, memory, and habit-learning.

buildSteps.title: Develop expression behaviors
buildSteps.detail: Map internal states to movements, lights, and sounds, and author animations and reactions.

buildSteps.title: Build the companion app and cloud backend
buildSteps.detail: Create setup, data sync, privacy controls, and remote update systems.

buildSteps.title: Manufacture and assemble
buildSteps.detail: Injection-mold the shell, assemble printed circuit boards, and do final assembly and quality testing.

buildSteps.title: Train and fine-tune
buildSteps.detail: Use field data to improve personalization and reduce errors while protecting user privacy.

buildSteps.title: Deploy and update
buildSteps.detail: Roll out over-the-air updates, monitor safety and privacy, and add new capabilities over time.
